## Realistic-look checklist (mandatory for every object added or changed)
- [ ] Materials chosen from what the real surface is made of: `ro` (finish table) and `bp` (relief table) set in the generator
- [ ] Built from group `box` / `rbox` / `tube` (movable as one piece; added to the base too, hidden, if it belongs to an alternative version); light on triangles and textures
- [ ] No new lamp, bulb or light unless the owner asked; at night the only light is the existing lamp; by day light only through existing openings
- [ ] Verified: `npm test`, a day and a night screenshot; anything not verified is listed below
